test_autocorr: test the Series autocorr method to compute autocorrelation with optional lag parameter
test_autocorr_with_lag: test the Series autocorr method with a specific lag value and compare with corr(shift())
test_autocorr_short_series: test the Series autocorr method on a short series with length <= 2 to verify NaN return
test_autocorr_vs_corr_shift: test that Series autocorr(lag=n) equals Series.corr(Series.shift(n)) for random lag values
test_autocorr_default_lag: test the Series autocorr method with default lag=1 and verify it matches explicit lag=1
